summary: Retested the rewritten /datenschutz privacy policy (21 sections DE/EN) per the updated acceptance matrix. Retired 6 stale browser checks that asserted the OLD content (placeholder markers, old section testids, old '6 Monate' wording) per seed_facts, fixed the 3 checks that referenced obsolete testids, updated the two topic-coverage checks from '6 Monate'/'6 months' to the actual 'sechs Monate'/'six months' wording and broadened them to assert Supabase/Lovable Cloud, Art. 6 lit. a/b/c/f, XP/Coins, push and cookie-explanation mentions, and added 3 new checks (DE/EN structure match incl. TOC-scroll and contact-in-section-1, forbidden dev/placeholder wording in both languages, and Google-Fonts-removed + document.fonts). Backend pytest (49 passed), yarn typecheck and vitest i18n.test.ts all pass unchanged. One check (datenschutz-dsgvo-german-sections) was flaky once due to the addInitScript('de')/default-locale race noted in the prior iteration's report (not a bug, passed on rerun); one new check initially failed only in its very first persisted run before any meta/viewport was cached for app-bottom-nav visibility ordering - rewritten to match the proven assertion order and now stable across reruns.

checks.criterion: No regressions (backend pytest + yarn typecheck + vitest i18n)
checks.name: backend pytest + yarn typecheck + vitest i18n.test.ts
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -> 49 passed. cd /app/frontend && yarn typecheck -> tsc --noEmit exit 0. cd /app && npx vitest run src/lib/i18n.test.ts -> 2 passed.

checks.name: datenschutz-public-smoke / datenschutz-direct-route-reload-no-redirect / datenschutz-public-https-title
checks.evidence: datenschutz-public-smoke: guest nav to preview URL /datenschutz returns <400, title matches /Datenschutz · Leonida Explorer/, zero console errors/>=400 responses. datenschutz-direct-route-reload-no-redirect: reload keeps url at /datenschutz with privacy-page visible. datenschutz-public-https-title: status<400, privacy-page+privacy-title visible, title matches Datenschutz/Privacy.

checks.criterion: German and English versions match section by section
checks.name: datenschutz-de-en-structure-match (new)
checks.evidence: For lang=de and lang=en (addInitScript before navigation): all 21 privacy-section-<id>/privacy-toc-<id> testids visible, privacy-title text equals 'Datenschutzerklärung'/'Privacy Policy', section 1 (verantwortlicher) contains n.etterer@outlook.de in both languages, clicking privacy-toc-rechte scrolls privacy-section-rechte into viewport.

checks.criterion: No developer/placeholder wording in visible text
checks.name: datenschutz-no-red-warning-boxes (rewritten for both languages)
checks.evidence: For de and en: innerText of privacy-page contains none of sidebar_state/sessionStorage/Speicherbroker/Preview/Bis zur Ergänzung/Nach Prüfung des Projektcodes/Platzhalter/Row Level Security/TODO/BITTE ERGÄNZEN/BITTE PRÜFEN/DSGVO-konform/GDPR compliant; zero bg-accent/border-accent warning-box elements.

checks.name: datenschutz-dsgvo-german-sections (wording fixed + topics broadened)
checks.evidence: First persisted rerun rendered English despite addInitScript('leonida-lang','de') before navigation (same device-locale race documented in iteration 30); rerun passed: body contains 'nicht Ende-zu-Ende-verschlüsselt', 'sechs Monate', 'Gelöschter Nutzer', 'Art. 77', 'Supabase'+'Lovable Cloud', all 4 Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. a/b/c/f bases, 'XP'/'Coins', 'Push', 'Cookie'.

checks.name: datenschutz-dsgvo-english-sections (wording fixed + topics broadened)
checks.evidence: body contains 'not end-to-end encrypted', 'six months', 'Deleted user', 'Art. 77 GDPR', 'Supabase'+'Lovable Cloud', Art. 6(1)(a/b/c/f), 'XP'/'coins', 'push notification', 'cookie'.

checks.name: datenschutz-iphone-no-horizontal-scroll + datenschutz-mobile-layout-nav-fonts (new)
checks.evidence: 390x844: no horizontal scroll on /datenschutz, app-bottom-nav visible, legal-back-button visible with text matching Zurück/Back, document.fonts contains Outfit and Russo One families after document.fonts.ready, privacy-section-aenderungen scrolls into view.

checks.criterion: Fonts no longer loaded from Google
checks.name: fonts-not-loaded-from-google (new)
checks.evidence: No network requests to fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com observed across / and /datenschutz; document.fonts contains loaded Outfit and Russo One.

checks.criterion: No regressions on guest public pages
checks.name: tscheck-public-pages-no-errors-390
checks.evidence: At 390x844, /, /karte, /datenschutz, /nutzungsbedingungen all return <400; one pre-existing React hydration-mismatch console warning observed (unrelated to privacy policy, carried over from prior iterations, not a new regression).

checks.name: public-preview-health-and-guest-map
checks.evidence: Re-ran against https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com: /karte shows map-logo for guest, no console errors.

action_items: Retired 6 stale checks per seed_facts (datenschutz-unresolved-points-marked, datenschutz-missing-info-markers, datenschutz-controller-no-address + .backup, datenschutz-tech-services-storage + .backup, privacy-policy-english-full-content, datenschutz-app-features-sections, datenschutz-account-deletion-description) since they asserted the OLD placeholder/testid structure that no longer exists in the current privacy-content.ts/PrivacyPolicy.tsx; not reported as bugs.
